purpose: Teach: 授与/保健所/延命/即答/一辺倒/疲弊/病名/早けれ

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 当社、社員に新人賞の授与をいたしましょう
lines.en: Let's award our new employee with the newcomer prize.
lines.style: Measured, decisive. Clear opening attack on the proposal. Businesslike pace, no softening. Authority without coldness—a leader laying out what comes next.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。保健所への報告書、提出済みです
lines.en: Yes. The health department report has already been submitted.
lines.style: Clipped, efficient. Slight upward tick on confirmation—pride in having completed the task. Professional cadence, no elaboration needed.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 当社、サービスは延命を視野に検討しましょう
lines.en: Let's explore extending the service lifespan as a strategic direction.
lines.style: Calm, forward-thinking. Opens with quiet conviction. Measured pace—this is a vision, not a rush. Slight emphasis on 'explore' to signal collaborative thinking, not mandate.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。即答できる窓口を増やしました
lines.en: Yes. I've expanded the number of counters that can provide immediate responses.
lines.style: Direct, competent. Quick rhythm on 'expanded'—showing initiative. Factual, light with accomplishment but not boastful. Steady eye-level tone.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 価格一辺倒のキャンペーンはやめましょう
lines.en: Let's move away from price-focused campaigns.
lines.style: Firm pivot. Sharp attack on the opening. Resolute but not harsh—this is a course correction the team needs. Slightly slower landing on the final word.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。サポート要員、疲弊を防ぐローテーション組みます
lines.en: Yes. I'm setting up a rotation system to prevent burnout in the support team.
lines.style: Responsive and caring underneath the professionalism. Opens with quick acceptance, then settles into the detail with genuine concern for the staff. Warm but not sentimental.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お客様への病名告知ガイドラインを作りましょう
lines.en: Let's develop guidelines for communicating diagnoses to customers.
lines.style: Thoughtful, careful. Soft opening—this is delicate work. Deliberate pace, emphasis on 'communicating' to highlight the human element. Ending slightly open, inviting input.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。早ければ今月中にお披露目します
lines.en: Yes. We can have it ready to present as early as this month.
lines.style: Confident close. Quick acceptance, then a clear timeline. Light optimism in the tone—'as early as' suggests capability and momentum. Finishing solid, wrapping the exchange.
